author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the launch trailer for Sherman Commander, available now on PC via Steam. 
Sherman Commander brings a new perspective on realism in tactical tank warfare simulation by presenting the tank as a slow, lumbering war machine that requires the effort of the entire crew to operate. Command your own vehicle together with a whole platoon of Sherman tanks over the most famous theatres of WW2. Take the commander’s seat and give specific orders to your crew and remaining tanks, or open the tactical map to coordinate your actions with accompanying units.
title: Sherman Commander - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the latest teaser for Permafrost, where exploration, resourcefulness, and crafting are the order of the day as players construct intricate shelters from scrap, cultivate crops to stave off hunger, and harness the power of technology to fend off threats both human and environmental. Permafrost will launch into Early Access on PC later this year.
title: Permafrost - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Devil Jam, the hand-drawn, metal-themed survivor-like beat-driven combat set in Hell, will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch on March 26, 2026.
title: Devil Jam - Official Console Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Helluva Heist, a chaotic and high-stakes bank robbery experience developed by Kronia Technologies. Assemble your crew to secure a massive $15M payday by executing the perfect heist, or play as a Disruptor to sow chaos and hunt down the robbers. Only one side will emerge as the ultimate winner. Helluva Heist is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Helluva Heist - Official Announcement Trailer
